criteria.C1: bending: the test moment at Theta_D = theta lies between the two splice models' moments, each widened by the reading tolerance
criteria.C2: axial: the test's mean LVDT displacement at T_kN lies between the two models' displacements, widened by the reading tolerance
criteria.C3: bending: the increase of bolt 1's force between the two bolt moments lies between the two models' increases, widened by the reading tolerance
criteria.verdict: PASS if and only if C1, C2 and C3 hold; a criterion whose model values are missing or come from a level that did not converge, or broke a KKT limit, does not hold

axial.stop: after the first level with T >= T_kN + 50 kN

bending.stop: after the first level with Theta_D >= 1.2 theta and M >= the larger bolt moment + 5 kNm

model.code: fejoint.chs.SpliceModel, half joint about the bending plane, one side of the splice
model.fixed_geometry: tube 323.9 mm outside diameter, wall 12.4 mm; 12 bolts, first at 15 degrees from the tension extreme fibre; holes 21 mm; bearing radius 17.3 mm; unfused root 3.4 mm; fillet leg 8 mm; tube modelled to 600 mm beyond the plate; measuring ring 100 mm from the plate's outer face (fejoint.chs.FlangeSplice defaults)

materials.hardening: f1/materials.py: true stress against equivalent plastic strain from the coupon curve between engineering strains 0.004 and eu (thesis eqs 2.21 and 2.22), from fy at zero plastic strain, non-decreasing, at most 14 points; beyond necking thesis eq. 2.23 with the coupon's w, at true strains 1.5 and 2.5 times the necking strain and 0.6, final slope to 1.0

measured_preload.rule: bolts 1 to 6 at the bolt forces of Fig. 3.4 at 25 kNm: bolt 1 the upper and bolt 2 the lower dotted series, bolts 3 and 4 the cyan lines, bolt 5 the upper and bolt 6 the lower red series; reported only
